steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ in Master QCS; the prepared state already contains the required bids and quantities.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared event.
Confirm the prepared line quantity is the required 10 units.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate is 100 per unit.
Verify the comparison grid calculates Vendor A's line amount and total as rate multiplied by quantity.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate all 10 requested units to Vendor A.
Confirm one line and one vendor are selected and the proposal total is 1,000.
Open the proposal page after completing the allocation.
Assert that the proposal page opened.
Confirm the proposal identifies Vendor A as the allocated vendor.
Confirm the proposal carries the allocated quantity of 10 units.
Confirm the proposal uses Vendor A's bid price of 100.
Complete any mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Submit the completed award proposal for approval.
Assert the submitted proposal remains on the proposal workflow.

args.need: sign in as the approver, reject the submitted proposal with a remark, verify no purchase order was created, and return to the buyer's Master QCS

steps.note: The approver's separate login and rejection action are not available to the catalog.
Verify the buyer can start awarding again after the proposal rejection.
